title: Beyond Passwords: Secure Authentication with Mozilla Persona
summary: Dan Callahan presents Mozilla Persona, a decentralized, cross-browser authentication system that removes site passwords, at PyCon 2013. He explains how the protocol works and how to add it to a Python site.
why: HN cites it as the best explanation of how Persona's provisioning and login work, and of why it used email addresses as identity.

quote.text: It is a very elegant, decentralised solution to the login problem.
